settings.content:
• Fabric: Made from 100% fine cotton, ensuring a soft, breathable feel that keeps you comfortable throughout the day.

  • Yarn-Dyed: The fabric is yarn-dyed, meaning the colors are woven into the fibers rather than printed, ensuring lasting vibrancy and a premium finish.

  • GSM 220: The medium-weight fabric (220 GSM) offers durability while maintaining a comfortable, lightweight feel.

  • Fit: Designed in a regular fit, offering a structured yet relaxed silhouette for all-day wear.

settings.title: Reviews (3)
settings.content:
• Dual-Tone Aesthetic: A rich brown base complemented by deep black sleeves and accents, adding a bold yet refined contrast.

  • Vertical Panel Detailing: Sleek, parallel stripes running down the torso enhance the structured look, adding a touch of vintage-inspired sophistication.

  • Classic Polo Collar: A clean-cut, buttoned neckline that balances casual comfort with formal polish.

Whether you're pairing it with tailored trousers for a polished office look or styling it with joggers for a smart-casual vibe, this product is designed to keep you looking sharp, confident, and effortlessly stylish.
